name: Mondi plc
source: CRON 2026-10-14: H1 2026 column added from Mondi plc Half Year Results Announcement 2026, condensed consolidated income statement page 12 and financial summary page 2, six months ended 30 June 2026, from mondigroup.com. EUR million stored as absolute euro: Group revenue 3,975; materials, energy and consumables used 2,070; variable selling expenses 388; gross margin 1,517; maintenance and other indirect expenses 184; personnel costs 722; other net operating expenses 256; EBITDA 355; depreciation, amortisation and impairments 533; operating loss 178; net loss from joint ventures 1; net finance costs 58; investment income 9; foreign currency gains 1; finance costs 68; net monetary loss from hyperinflationary economies 3; loss before tax 240; tax charge 3; loss for the period 243; loss attributable to shareholders 255 with 12 of profit attributable to non-controlling interests. Basic loss per share 57.8 euro cents. Mapping: Cost of Sales is materials, energy and consumables used plus variable selling expenses, which reproduces the printed gross margin of 1,517 as gross profit; Operating Expenses is maintenance and other indirect expenses plus personnel costs plus other net operating expenses, and gross profit less that equals the printed operating loss of 178. Net Profit follows the file own convention of the attributable figure (255): loss before tax less the 3 tax charge is 243, the remaining 12 being non-controlling interests.
